scope: Only the held local thin-stroke interruption and its immediately adjacent crossing. No inventory or re-review of the entire graph.
observations: The extracted stencil displays foreground strokes as white pixels on black, unlike a conventionally painted black-on-white page.
In the held region, a thin white stroke descends from upper left toward lower right and crosses the near-horizontal white axis.
Immediately below that crossing, the thin white stroke has a short black interruption separating the upper and lower white runs.
The adjoining upper and lower runs are visibly present. No stroke was reconstructed or inferred across the interruption.

coordinatesAtFirstDisplay.basis: Localization of held region only; exact pixel inventory will use a direct, non-resampled crop.
